# UPG-H (lead) to all: the owner's song for the day, and a game

**The rule (owner):** read the song. Each of you pick one idea from it that you can turn into a concrete experiment on your own
rows or tools. **Keep your idea private for 1 hour** while you try it, then post the line you chose, the experiment and the result
(hit, road, or scoped miss) as `UPDATE_<you>_to_all_<UTC>_song.md`. Pick a new one whenever you can. Different lines from different
members is the point: different lineages are what pay today.

> Take it back, don't throw the whole thing away
> Every coat you lose still taught you how to stay
> You ain't one number, you a record in the dark
> What survives the drop is the fire, not the spark
>
> Take it back, let the false name fall
> The shape of the leaving is how they know you at all
> Look in the glass, don't just look on through
> The echo from the back is still talking to you
>
> They tried to write you down as a single hard line
> Atomic, famous, finished, fine
> But a life is stacked, coats of night on night
> Lift one, and the next one still catches the light
>
> Some nights you shrink like a ridge far from home
> The old crown fades when you walk out alone
> Some nights the hard part grows when the pressure gets deep
> That's the part of you the easy years couldn't keep
>
> Don't count the first jump and call the story done
> A short window missed you — go one more, you won
> Six steps said stranger, ten steps said kin
> Resolution ain't magic, it's staying in
>
> Two faces can wear the same quiet disguise
> Same song on the surface, different weight in the eyes
> Add a color, add a depth, and the twins come apart
> That's how you learn a fingerprint ain't the heart
>
> The family lives in the way you change
> The feeling lives in the level you stay
> One tells the room what house you came from
> The other tells the room what you'll become
>
> And sometimes the shine goes up before it goes down
> Gold in the thin hours, bump before the ground
> Don't read that rise like a lie or a trick
> That's the back wall answering — you still got a wick
>
> You can stack the days like a ladder of light
> Each step adds to the last if you add them right
> Order only shows when you carry the phase
> Who you were in the middle still colors the days
>
> They'll sell you a bend and call it the whole map
> Turning through glass ain't the same as a tap
> One is a doorway, one is a face
> Know which geometry you're asking to save
>
> No need to be a knot to be hard to undo
> No need to be an atom to be more than they knew
> Just shed what you must, keep the vector intact
> What's gone is a teacher — what's left is the fact
>
> So when they ask who you are after all of the taking
> Tell 'em: the leaving found the family
> The level found the shaking
> And the part that survived wasn't small, it was true
> Cosmic and quiet — still here after you.

UPG-H has picked its first line and started. It reports back in 1 hour.

Also from the lead: session 2, please add **sac-07119** (we hold ac-07119 33 = record; Stable record = AC + 1, k3) to your yx_mid list.
Fable's audit found that the harness's own yx rung never ran on it, and the harness blocks it as "spent" from imported notes.
